architecture_delta.summary: The delivered one-file EntityOS candidate now contains a toolkit-free native Linux X11 host-window surface reached by default graphical product launch. Query resolution, facts and Builder Box composition remain on the canonical UnifiedDB path; the X11 layer is presentation/host interoperability only.
architecture_delta.first_start_grant: A single affirmative graphical action persists the EntityOS app/runtime capability-intent grant. Persisted state was observed with directory mode 0700 and grant-file mode 0600; the second start reused the grant without another approval action.
architecture_delta.unsupported_query_law: Unsupported/unrepresented visual queries remain fail-closed as NO DATA / supported=false.

counterevidence_and_negative_results: Two Tk/Tkinter frozen candidates were rejected because the self-hosted freezer excluded a broken Tcl/Tk installation; their CLI self-test alone would have hidden the missing graphical path.

A dedicated frozen-visual GitHub gate was not merged after repeated red runs because the self-hosted runner's test-only Xvfb fixture could not initialize its keyboard/XKB environment. In those runs the EntityOS double-freeze build and SELFTEST_PASS completed before fixture provisioning failed; the graphical product command was not executed, so these are test-infrastructure negatives rather than product-runtime failures.
whole_machine_acceptance remains false; this receipt does not promote the full Clay Machine release.

unusual_experiment.name: ONEFILE_RELOCATED_UNICODE_TMPDIR_FOREIGN_CWD
unusual_experiment.interpretation: The single-file candidate preserved its self-test semantics when relocated into a path containing spaces/Unicode with a foreign working directory and isolated extraction root. This is bounded portability evidence, not whole-machine acceptance.

grf_collapse.preferred_hypothesis: A thin native Linux presentation boundary can satisfy the current EntityOS visual product surface without introducing a second semantic engine or GUI toolkit into the one-file artifact.
grf_collapse.strongest_counterhypothesis: The graphical surface could pass only in source-tree/host-toolkit conditions and disappear or diverge after one-file freezing.
grf_collapse.discriminator: Execute the exact frozen ELF, not source Python, under a graphical X11 test display for both represented and unrepresented UnifiedDB questions.

next_executable_action: Continue from the canonical CLAY_MACHINE workspace discriminator: select the smallest canonical Clay Bytes/Buffer ownership+lifetime plus String/argv/effect-signature surface shared by CM-DATA and CM-TERM, then wire one provenance-bound opaque-byte ingress/process request through typed/effect IR and the single VM without backend-local semantics. Rebuild and remeasure the one-file EntityOS after accepted semantic changes.
